rules.expr: !(root.protocol in ["ydb_grpc", "ydb_grpcs"]) || root.segments.all(s, s.workload.script != "tpcds" || ((! ("query_stream" in s.workload) || s.workload.query_stream == null) && (!("streams" in s.workload) || s.workload.streams == 1)))
rules.message: YDB TPC-DS supports the baked query set only

rules.expr: root.protocol != "picodata" || root.segments.all(s, s.workload.script != "tpcds" || ("no_steps" in s && "workload" in s.no_steps) || ("steps" in s && size(s.steps) > 0 && !("workload" in s.steps)))
rules.message: Picodata TPC-DS supports loading only; exclude the workload step

rules.expr: !("connection" in root) || !("protocol" in root) || root.connection.kind == (root.protocol.startsWith("ydb") ? "ydb" : root.protocol)
size(root.segments.map(s, s.name)) == size(root.segments.map(s, s.name).filter(n, root.segments.filter(x, x.name == n).size() == 1))
